readme.section: DSH Reply Beautify · 回复美化
readme.text:
让 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复更易读：三种排版风格、可操作的图表与表格，以及隔离的 HTML 小作品。保留 DSH 页面结构，随时查看原文。

**非官方社区插件 · MIT · 0.6.5 预发布** · [English](README.en.md) · [下载与 Release](https://github.com/ErSu137/dsh-reply-beautify/releases/tag/v0.6.5)

**0.6.1 更新**：更主动的可视化指引；普通比例图形完整适配，极端比例保留滚动；图上滚轮缩放，双击或“自动”恢复。短数字横轴的折线图更紧凑，保留全部数据。[使用与验收](docs/0.6.1.md)。模型仍可能不遵循指引，旧 ASCII 回复不会自动重绘。

上图为使用实际插件代码制作的通用样例。[查看全部六张演示图](docs/demo/README.md)：四张独立样例，以及两张已裁去账号与会话侧栏的 DSH 实机组件截图。图片来源均有标注。

readme.section: DSH Reply Beautify · 回复美化
readme.text:
下载当前源码后，可打开 `docs/demo/index.html` 浏览图片，或打开[交互样例](docs/demo/interactive.html)切换系列、修改输入和运行作品；无需账号，不连接模型。

已验收图片保留 0.6.0 时的展示；0.6.1 缩放可在交互样例中试用。

适用于 **Windows DSH Desktop，接口兼容依据 0.2.1-rc.2**。默认路径及自定义路径支持同一套安装命令；自定义位置使用 `-Installation 'D:\DeepSeek Harness'`，检查、安装、卸载均可传入，详见[路径与版本检查](docs/安装更新与恢复.md#dsh-安装在-d-盘或其他目录)。其他平台和版本、最终视觉及长会话仍待验证；请先在专用测试对话验收。

1. 从 [Release](https://github.com/ErSu137/dsh-reply-beautify/releases/tag/v0.6.5) 下载 `dsh-reply-beautify-0.6.5.zip` 与 `SHA256SUMS-0.6.5.txt`。选择命名的安装包；GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 归档供开发者使用。
2. 用 `Get-FileHash .\dsh-reply-beautify-0.6.5.zip -Algorithm SHA256` 比对校验值，再解压至长期保留的文件夹，例如 `D:\Plugins\dsh-reply-beautify`。解压后进入包含 `install.ps1` 和 `package.json` 的内层目录。
3. 确保 DSH 至少启动过一次，然后通过“应用 → 退出”完全退出。在该目录打开 PowerShell：

```powershell
   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Check
   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
   ```

4. 重新启动 DSH，打开左下账户行的画笔，确认版本 **0.6.5**。在新建的测试对话试用。

`-Check` 只读，安装器调用安装目录内的官方 CLI，以 `link:`、`--offline --ignore-scripts` 添加插件，无需下载依赖。**插件持续从解压目录加载，不要移动或删除该目录。** 默认 profile 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`；设置了 `DSH_HOME` 时跟随该变量。备份保存在该插件目录的 `backups` 中，请勿上传。
详细操作、错误恢复与高级 tgz 用法见[安装、更新与恢复](docs/安装更新与恢复.md)。当前未发布 npm 包，也未提交到自定义插件市场。

- **阅读排版**：默认、ChatGPT、Claude 三种预设；调正文字号、代码字号、行距、段间距。部分界面字体、字标及强调色随风格变化。Claude 普通强调色为橙色，轨迹保留紫、绿、金等语义色。
- **图示与计算**：可靠的 ASCII 字段图、关系图、部分 Mermaid TD/LR 流程图、数据图表及明确公式；交互图表、参数滑块与曲线、自测题、表单。
- **通用工具**：搜索/排序/编辑表格与 CSV 导出、计算器、加权方案比较、参数情景、时间轴/甘特/日历、清单/看板、层级、分步播放、分支向导、差异、来源卡片、联动报告。具体数量与格式上限见[格式与限制](docs/高通用性功能-格式与限制.md)。
- **作品空间**：按[作品格式](docs/第五阶段-作品格式.md)运行 HTML/CSS/JavaScript，支持回复内、侧栏、全屏预览，以及本机版本编辑。使用状态 API 的输入可以恢复。

直接提出任务即可，例如“比较甲乙丙预算工时 12、18、9 和实际工时 10、20、8，用图表展示”，或“用可调整输入的计算器比较投入成本”。插件给模型提供只读格式指南，模型自主选择组件，**不保证每次生成**。流式回复中，完整且校验通过的块可以先呈现，后文继续输出。无效或不支持的内容保留原文。

只增强助手正式回复，用户消息、推理和工具输出不参与组件转换；普通代码不会自动执行。来源、评分与题目答案来自模型，插件不替你核实事实。
这两张是独立通用样例；[可编辑表格](docs/demo/03-table.png)、[DSH 实机图表](docs/demo/05-dsh-chart.png)和[实机参数曲线](docs/demo/06-dsh-curve.png)见完整画廊。图片验收不等于全部功能或跨平台验收。

更新前保留旧版目录，下载新版到新目录；完全退出 DSH 后，在新目录运行安装脚本并重启。原有设置键保持兼容；回退时在保留的旧目录重新运行安装脚本。

| 操作 | 影响 |
| --- | --- |
| 画笔关闭“启用美化” | 恢复显示原文、停止预览；Host 中模型格式指南仍在 |
| DSH 插件管理停用 | 由框架停用客户端与 Host 能力；必要时完全退出并重启 |
| 完全退出后运行 `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall` | 官方 CLI 移除插件注册，变更前备份 profile 配置 |

上述操作均不主动删除本机偏好、交互和作品记录。备份不等于聊天备份；不要手动混合恢复单份 profile 配置。

偏好、交互数据、作品代码和 API 状态保存在本机 DSH 浏览器存储，可能含你输入的内容。普通持久状态最多 80 条/约 280000 字符，临时缓存 160 条/560000 字符；作品最多 12 个、各 6 版，总记录约 180 万字符，单份 API 状态 24000 字符。超限会淘汰旧记录；存储失败有提示，不承诺跨设备同步或永久保留。插件本身不自动发送消息或上传这些数据；DSH 发给模型的内容由 DSH 自身处理。

作品在双层不透明来源的 sandbox iframe 中运行，仅允许脚本；CSP 限制外部资源、连接和子框架。不提供文件、Node/Electron、聊天历史或工具桥梁。**隔离不能保证任意模型作品绝对安全，也不提供 CPU/内存硬限额**，忙循环仍可能卡顿。普通表达式只解析受限算术。CSV 已对危险前缀作文本转义，重新保存/导入的行为受表格软件影响。

复杂 Mermaid、循环/时序图等仍可能显示原文；公式复用 DSH 原生渲染。DOM 选择器与侧栏接口依赖 DSH 版本。ChatGPT/Claude 仅为风格参考，没有官方关联，也不打包字体或原应用资源。

本次维护更新：95 项 Node 测试、Windows PowerShell 5.1/PowerShell 7 各 54 项隔离安装断言，以及 15 项归档检查通过；真实安装内 CLI 在临时 profile 和默认/自定义目录别名下完成安装、自检、卸载。范围与限制见[发布检查报告](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS.md)。这不代表全平台、多版本或真实用户环境完整验收。[手工安装验收与周末测试清单](docs/TESTING.md)可直接照做。

无需安装运行依赖。开发用 Node 22+（本轮 24.19.0）、Python 3.9+ 和 PowerShell：

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
.\tests\installer.test.ps1
node scripts/build-demo.mjs

可选浏览器检查使用 Playwright 和本机 Chromium，见 `scripts/check-browser.cjs`；不触碰 DSH。公开包采用明确清单，排除 profile、work、backups 和旧截图。[有限安全检查](SECURITY.md) · [第三方说明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) · [变更记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [宣传草稿与发现渠道](docs/COMMUNITY.md)。历史阶段报告保留在 docs，历史数字不是本次验证结果。

An unofficial MIT community plugin for DeepSeek Harness: readable assistant replies, interactive charts and tables, and isolated HTML mini apps. It preserves the application layout and provides access to original content.

[中文说明](README.md) · [Download v0.6.5 preview](https://github.com/ErSu137/dsh-reply-beautify/releases/tag/v0.6.5)

**New in 0.6.1:** stronger visual guidance, automatic fitting for ordinary SVG diagrams, scrolling for extreme aspect ratios, hovered wheel zoom, buttons and double-click reset. Numeric-label line charts use a compact canvas without dropping data. [Details and acceptance](docs/0.6.1.md). Model compliance remains variable; old ASCII replies are not regenerated.

The image above uses actual plugin code with synthetic content. The [six-image gallery](docs/demo/README.md) contains four standalone samples and two cropped screenshots of generic test components running in DSH. Sources are labeled; account details and conversation sidebars are excluded.

From the current source checkout, open `docs/demo/index.html` for the gallery or [interactive.html](docs/demo/interactive.html) to try series toggles, calculator inputs, presets and a sandboxed counter. No account or model connection is needed.

Compatibility baseline: **Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2**. All installer modes accept `-Installation 'D:\DeepSeek Harness'` (directory or full executable path). Without it, the installer checks the default path and registered locations, and asks for an explicit path if missing or ambiguous. Other platforms/versions and final visual/long-conversation acceptance remain pending. This release is a preview.

1. Download the named `dsh-reply-beautify-0.6.5.zip` and `SHA256SUMS-0.6.5.txt` from the Release. Compare `Get-FileHash .\dsh-reply-beautify-0.6.5.zip -Algorithm SHA256` with the checksum.
2. Extract into a permanent directory; enter the inner folder containing `install.ps1` and `package.json`. Launch DSH once to initialize its desktop profile, then fully quit it.
3. In PowerShell in that folder, run:

```powershell
   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Check
   powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
   ```

4. Restart DSH, open the brush next to the account row, and confirm 0.6.5. Use a new test conversation.

The installer invokes the installed official CLI with `link:`, `--offline --ignore-scripts`. **Keep the extracted directory in place.** It backs up profile configuration under `backups/` before changes. The desktop profile follows `DSH_HOME` if set, otherwise `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop`. No npm or custom marketplace publication is claimed.

Default, ChatGPT and Claude typography presets with font/code sizes, line height and paragraph spacing. Reliable structured diagrams and limited Mermaid flows, charts, parameter curves, quizzes and forms. Searchable/editable tables with CSV, calculators, weighted decisions, schedules, boards, trees, playback, branching wizards, diffs, source cards and linked reports. HTML/CSS/JavaScript artifacts support inline/sidebar/fullscreen previews, local revisions and explicit state API restoration.

Ask naturally; the model receives a read-only format guide and decides when to use components. It does not always produce them. Complete validated streaming blocks can render while later prose continues. Unsupported content retains the original text. Only formal assistant replies are enhanced. Ordinary code is not automatically executed. Model data, answers and citations are not independently verified.

Brush off restores original display and stops previews, while model guides remain registered. Native plugin disable removes client and Host capabilities through DSH. To uninstall, fully quit DSH and run `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall`. Restart after changes. Update by retaining the old folder and installing from the new one; reinstall from the old folder to roll back.

Preferences, interaction inputs, artifact code and API state stay in local DSH browser storage and are not actively deleted on disable/uninstall. Retention is bounded: 80 persistent interaction records/~280000 characters; 160 temporary records/560000 characters; 12 artifacts with up to 6 revisions each/~1.8M total characters, 24000 per API state. Old records may be evicted. No cross-device or permanent storage promise.

Artifacts use nested opaque-origin `sandbox="allow-scripts"` frames and CSP restrictions; no filesystem, Node/Electron, chat-history or model-tool bridge is provided. **This is not a guarantee that arbitrary generated apps are safe, nor a CPU/memory quota.** Ordinary calculations use a limited arithmetic parser. CSV text escaping may be affected by subsequent spreadsheet save/import behavior. Complex Mermaid syntax and unsupported diagrams fall back to source.

These two images are standalone samples. See the gallery for the [editable table](docs/demo/03-table.png), [real DSH chart](docs/demo/05-dsh-chart.png) and [real DSH parameter explorer](docs/demo/06-dsh-curve.png). Screenshot approval does not imply complete DSH or cross-platform acceptance.

No runtime dependency installation is required. Node 22+ (tested 24.19.0), Python 3.9+, PowerShell:

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs
node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/*.test.mjs
.\tests\installer.test.ps1
node scripts/build-demo.mjs

95 Node tests, 54 isolated installer assertions on each of Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7, and 15 archive checks passed. The installation-owned CLI completed add/check/remove with temporary profiles through default/custom directory aliases; the application was not physically moved to another drive. Existing approved screenshots retain the 0.6.0 display. See [release evidence](docs/RELEASE_CHECKS.md), [manual testing](docs/TESTING.md), [security scope](SECURITY.md), [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). No bundled fonts, original DSH assets or private conversations. ChatGPT and Claude presets are style references without official affiliation.
